cardOverview.overviewText: A First Select card providing lifestyle rewards, shopping perks, and milestone vouchers, crafted for mid-tier professionals.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: This service provides a modern, personalized experience for you to self-book your dining, staycation, flights and activities.
benefitRows.howToAvail: You may dial 1800 210 0298 (toll-free) or 022-42320298 for concierge assistance.

benefitRows.name: District
benefitRows.offer: B1G1 offer on movie tickets upto ₹125 on District mobile app (valid twice per month).
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the District app and book movie tickets. Use your IDFC First Select credit card to get Buy One Get One Free (B1G1) offer up to ₹125, valid twice per month. For queries, contact IDFC FIRST Bank customer care at 1860 267 3333.
